scenes.name: intro
scenes.caption: OpenBridge Capability Forge. This is the SIMULATED fallback: a real local service and a live local Meta call, using synthetic relay observations. No physical scan or change occurs.

scenes.name: live-meta
scenes.caption: LIVE REQUEST: pinned Meta Muse Glimmer, running locally on CPU. No provider credits or cloud fallback. The model may propose a plan; it cannot authorize publication.

scenes.name: path
scenes.caption: A workspace reads through an approved relay. The fixture TV observes a nearby signal source. Permissions, provenance and freshness are checked by deterministic policy.

scenes.name: waiting
scenes.caption: The local model is processing the complete structured proposal. Even a valid proposal cannot grant consent, invent an approved primitive, or change a device.

scenes.name: validated
scenes.caption: ACTUAL GLIMMER OUTPUT: read the verified relay observations, then publish a read-only local service. Exact IDs, transition order, evidence and post-inference freshness passed validation.

scenes.name: consent
scenes.caption: Only now does the owner consent. The host rereads the source before publishing; model text is never executed as code.

scenes.name: http-read
scenes.caption: The authenticated local API returns signal strength, source, observation time and evidence. The response explicitly says simulation=true. No temperature or battery measurement is invented.

scenes.name: contract
scenes.caption: A deterministic compiler emits OpenAPI 3.1, standalone schemas and a fixed Python client. This service uses approved read primitives only.

scenes.name: revoked
scenes.caption: A real authenticated verification probe now returns HTTP 404: SERVICE_REMOVED. Removing this virtual service does not alter the runtime relay or a phone setting.

scenes.name: limits
scenes.caption: The unfavorable v1 benchmark is retained. This constrained v2 development success is not an intelligence-advantage claim. Physical phone-relay snapshots are separate runtime-owner evidence; this recording stays synthetic.

scenes.name: closing
scenes.caption: github.com/toskaman/openbridge · feat/capability-forge · Meta Muse Glimmer actually used locally. Provider cost: $0. Validated proposal, owner consent, local API, and clean revocation.

claim: Actual live local Glimmer proposal and authenticated virtual API lifecycle; SIMULATED observations only; not benchmark or physical relay proof
